titulo.en: I will do, I will be able, I will leave

intro.en: The irregular futures, and the rule for if.

haré.en: I will do, I will make

saldré.en: I will go out, I will leave

dentro de.en: in (a period of time from now)
dentro de.nota: Dentro de dos años: two years from now.

texto.en:
The endings never change: **-é, -ás, -á, -emos, -éis, -án**. Twelve verbs change the stem they are added to.

- lose a vowel: poder → **podr**é, saber → **sabr**é, querer → **querr**é, haber → **habr**á
- take a d: tener → **tendr**é, venir → **vendr**é, poner → **pondr**é, salir → **saldr**é, valer → **valdr**á
- shorten: hacer → **har**é, decir → **dir**é

Use the future for predictions (mañana **lloverá**) and promises (te **llamaré**). For a plan already made, ir a is more usual: voy a comprar un coche.

A real condition is **si + present**, and then the future: **si tengo** tiempo, **iré**. The future never follows si.

**Dentro de** counts from now: dentro de dos años.

frases.en: What will you be doing in five years?

frases.es: No lo sé. Tendré otro trabajo y saldré menos.
frases.en: I don't know. I'll have another job and I'll go out less.

frases.es: Si ahorro dinero, podré comprar una casa.
frases.en: If I save money, I'll be able to buy a house.
frases.nota: After si, the present. Never si ahorraré.

frases.en: I'm sure there will be a lot of changes.

frases.es: Algún día te diré mis planes.
frases.en: Some day I'll tell you my plans.

pregunta.en: Complete: I will do it tomorrow.

haceré.en: The stem is har-, not hacer-.

pregunta.en: Complete: if I have time, I'll go.

tengo.en: After si, Spanish uses the present.

tendré.en: The future never follows si in a condition.

tenga.en: A real condition takes the indicative.

habrá.en: There will be: habrá, always singular.

habrán.en: It stays singular: habrá muchos cambios.

pregunta.en: Write the yo future of salir.

bloques.frase: Algún día te diré mis planes

traduccion.en: Some day I'll tell you my plans.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write about your life in ten years: where you will live, what you will do, what you will have.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Explain your plans for next year, using at least eight verbs in the future.
